extension.summary: A Kodi front end for RemoteTerm MeshCore -- with thanks to Jack Kingsman (https://github.com/jkingsman) and the RemoteTerm MeshCore contributors for building the project this addon is powered by, for the community.
extension.description:
A rich, fully custom-skinned RemoteTerm dashboard for Kodi. Categories: Dashboard (live stats + recent activity), Chats (colorful bubble messages, channels/DMs separated, favorites filter), Repeater Console (neighbors, access list, node info, CLI commands), Search, Contacts (filter by type, sort by recency/distance/hop count), a distance-and-bearing node list (no external map service required), and a live Packet Feed over WebSocket. Looks and behaves identically regardless of the active Kodi skin.
IMPORTANT: This is a front end only. You need a RemoteTerm backend already running and connected to your Mesh Radio -- without it, this Kodi addon has nothing to talk to and will not work. Setup instructions: https://gist.github.com/LA-Seniors/0d06033d441897e1f3bd067d89e421ba
This addon is only possible because of RemoteTerm MeshCore (https://github.com/jkingsman/Remote-Terminal-for-MeshCore), the open-source backend it connects to. Thanks to Jack Kingsman (https://github.com/jkingsman) and the other contributing developers (https://github.com/jkingsman/Remote-Terminal-for-MeshCore/graphs/contributors) for building and maintaining it for the community.
Built with help from Claude Code.
